name: M01-header-no-boundary
description: HEADER regex drops the 'space or EOL' boundary: '## C2x' becomes a valid claim

name: M02-badhead-never
description: BADHEAD regex can never match: HEADING-MALFORMED is never reported

name: M03-badhead-digit-optional
description: BADHEAD digit made optional: every '## C<n>' heading is also malformed

name: M04-keyline-drop-kill
description: KEYLINE no longer recognises the Kill key

name: M05-keyline-allow-indent
description: KEYLINE accepts indented key lines (grammar widening)

name: M06-dup-never-recorded
description: a repeated key is never added to the duplicate set: KEY-DUPLICATE never fires

name: M07-dup-class-renamed
description: KEY-DUPLICATE is reported under a different class name

name: M08-dup-key-still-evaluated
description: the duplicated key is no longer removed before evaluation (docstring says it is not evaluated)

name: M09-dup-unsorted
description: duplicates are reported in set order rather than sorted order

name: M10-symlink-mode-no-space
description: symlink mode test drops the trailing space (equivalent?)

name: M11-symlink-mode-wrong
description: symlink mode test uses the wrong mode string: symlinks are not detected

name: M12-symlink-at-rev-not-freeze
description: symlink is tested at REV instead of FREEZE-REV

name: M13-symlink-class-renamed
description: the symlink finding class is renamed

name: M14-symlink-any-type
description: is_symlink accepts any tree entry type, not only mode 120000

name: M15-dispatch-drop-dispatch
description: dispatch name test drops the '-dispatch' substring

name: M16-dispatch-drop-ready
description: dispatch name test drops the '.ready' substring

name: M17-dispatch-drop-json
description: dispatch name test drops the '-spec.json'/'-results.json' suffixes

name: M18-dispatch-name-is-full-path
description: dispatch name test uses the full path instead of the basename

name: M19-dispatch-ancestor-only-freeze
description: dispatch check drops the ancestor test: only the freeze commit itself counts

name: M20-dispatch-ancestor-only
description: dispatch check drops the c == freeze shortcut

name: M21-dispatch-first-setdefault
description: the oldest adding commit is no longer kept (newest wins)

name: M22-dispatch-tree-no-slash
description: the dispatch tree pathspec loses its trailing slash

name: M23-dispatch-missing-round-silent
description: a missing Round line no longer yields FIELD-MISSING C0 Round

name: M24-no-claims-removed
description: the NO-CLAIMS finding is never raised

name: M25-keys-drop-kill
description: the KEYS tuple drops Kill: a missing Kill key is not reported

name: M26-field-empty-never
description: an empty key value is never reported as FIELD-EMPTY

name: M27-heading-label-c1
description: HEADING-MALFORMED findings are labelled C1 instead of C0

name: M28-claim-label-shifted
description: claim labels are off by one

name: M29-base-commit-no-full40
description: the Base value is resolved even when it is not a full 40-hex id

name: M30-base-not-ancestor-drop
description: the BASE-NOT-ANCESTOR test loses the ancestor comparison

name: M31-base-ancestor-inverted
description: the ancestor comparison is inverted

name: M32-population-empty-threshold-1
description: POPULATION-EMPTY needs 1 non-blank line instead of 2

name: M33-population-empty-threshold-3
description: POPULATION-EMPTY needs 3 non-blank lines instead of 2

name: M34-control-first-line
description: the control receipt is read from its first line instead of its last

name: M35-control-exit-inverted
description: the red-control test is inverted (EXIT=0 is read as red)

name: M36-control-at-rev
description: the control receipt is read at REV instead of FREEZE-REV

name: M37-path-sha-no-spaces
description: PATH_SHA no longer accepts a repo path containing spaces

name: M38-path-sha-uppercase-hex
description: PATH_SHA accepts uppercase hex in the stated digest

name: M39-digest-compare-inverted
description: the stated digest is compared for equality instead of inequality

name: M40-no-sha256-not-reported
description: a Counter/Population value without sha256= is not reported

name: M41-frozen-edited-never
description: FROZEN-EDITED is never raised

name: M42-frozen-blob-at-rev
description: the freeze blob is read at REV: FROZEN-EDITED can never fire

name: M43-counter-missing-class
description: the missing-counter finding class is renamed

name: M44-keyline-trailing-space-kept
description: KEYLINE keeps trailing whitespace in the value

name: M45-population-blank-counted
description: POPULATION-EMPTY counts blank lines as content

name: M46-selftest-no-git-init
description: the self-test no longer initialises a git repository

name: M47-selftest-commit-without-staging
description: the self-test commits without staging the files it wrote

name: M48-selftest-cases-truncated
description: the self-test runs only the first 5 cases (cases=5 < 12)

name: M49-selftest-always-exit-0
description: the self-test always exits 0

name: M50-selftest-print-label
description: the self-test prints a label the counter does not parse

name: M51-selftest-exception-passes
description: a self-test case that raises is counted as a pass

name: M52-selftest-placeholder-swap
description: the '@'/'%' placeholders are swapped: the base commit is not the one under test

name: M53-selftest-no-orphan-commit
description: the self-test no longer creates the non-ancestor commit

name: M54-selftest-expectation-ignored
description: the self-test compares exit codes only, ignoring the expected findings

name: M55-selftest-sha-literal-wrong
description: a literal fixture digest in the self-test is wrong
